subject: Buying channel status & next steps (PO, card or marketplace?)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fincloud.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Buying channel status & next steps (PO, card or marketplace?)

Hi Liam —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum:

- Current ask: Proof-of-concept + pilot for customer-facing search re-rank.
- Primary technical canaries: latency under 120ms p95, token cost target ~0.7 cents/token.
- Procurement signal needed: which purchasing route will you use (PO / corporate card / AWS Marketplace)? This determines contract flow and timeline.

Requested from your side:
- Procurement contact (name + email) — so we can route a commercial PDF/quote and tax info.
- Any mandatory security docs (SOC 2, DPA requirements, IP restrictions).
- Target procurement timeline (ideal date to have PO signed).

Our deliverables this week:
- I'll send a formal quote and a short SOW for the pilot (RDW-QUOTE-FIN-2026-0781.pdf).
- We'll include SOC2 attestation and our standard DPA link.

Could you confirm the procurement path by end of week? If you intend to buy through AWS Marketplace we can prepare a marketplace SKU in parallel (shorter turnaround in some accounts).

Thanks — next step is a one-page procurement checklist I'll send once we confirm the route.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Schedule time: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/connor

Attachment: RDW-QUOTE-FIN-2026-0781.pdf (quote PDF stub)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fincloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Buying channel status & next steps (PO, card or marketplace?)

Thanks Connor — good summary. A few quick answers from procurement side:

- Purchasing routes: For >$50k annual commitments our standard is a PO + signed contract. For pilots under ~$5k teams often use corporate card or charged to a central devops card.
- Marketplace: We're evaluating AWS Marketplace for visibility and consolidated billing; procurement prefers Marketplace when available but requires parity on contract terms.
- Security: We will need SOC 2 Type II attestation and a DPA.

Procurement contact: Elena Park — Elena.Park@fincloud.com (ccing). She runs Commercial Procurement.

Timeline: If we go PO + contract expect ~3 weeks (internal review + finance). If card/marketplace it's typically 3–5 business days.

I'll coordinate with Elena and re-route the quote.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor | Head of Product 
FinCloud

Key questions for procurement to confirm:
1) Will you require a signed customer contract prior to issuing a PO, or can the PO reference our standard T&C and be accepted on issuance?
2) Are there any non-standard insurance / IP clauses we should pre-clear with your legal team?

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Buying channel status & next steps (PO, card or marketplace?)

Connor / Liam — thanks for the quote. A few procurement notes so expectations are aligned:

- Preferred route for this pilot size (~pilot-to-production scale) is PO + standard contract. We can issue a PO referencing RDW standard terms if Redwood confirms any material changes.
- Required docs before legal signs: SOC 2 attestation (Type II), our standard DPA (link to review), and a copy of your standard T&Cs.
- Timeline: assuming no major redlines, procurement + finance will need ~3 business weeks to process a PO.
- Attachments: sending our PO template for you to populate — FinCloud_PO_Template.docx

Questions for Redwood:
1) Who is the billing entity for Redwood Inference (legal name, tax ID, remit address)?
2) Do you accept Net 30? If not, advise alternatives.
3) If we decide to buy on AWS Marketplace, provide the marketplace listing name and list price so procurement can compare.

Please populate the PO template and return to procurement@fincloud.com. If you can provide the SOC2 PDF and DPA link this afternoon we can start legal review.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Commercial Procurement Manager | FinCloud
elena.park@fincloud.com | +1 (212) 555-0147

Attachment: FinCloud_PO_Template.docx (PO template)

Thanks Elena — really helpful. Quick reply with attachments and next steps from our side:

- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. | Tax ID: 94-1234567 | 450 Bryant St, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107.
- Invoice terms: Net 30 is acceptable.
- Attached: SOC2attestation-2025.pdf, Redwood-DPA-v3.1.pdf, RDW-QUOTE-FIN-2026-0781.pdf (finalized quote).

Action items / timeline:
- Today: Connor to populate FinCloud_PO_Template.docx and return to procurement@fincloud.com (attached).
- EOD Tue Oct 12: FinCloud legal to flag any contract redlines.
- By Fri Oct 23: Target for PO issuance (3-week procurement run if no major redlines).

Marketplace note: We can publish a marketplace SKU; to speed things we can run parallel (we'll prepare marketplace listing name + ops doc). Confirm if procurement prefers Marketplace parity or direct PO — both are options.

I'll return the populated PO template shortly in a separate email. If anyone on Redwood legal/finance wants to advise on unusual terms, Hannah and Ben are cc'd.

Connor O'Brien
